title: Sound Bath and Wellness Experience in Nashville
includes: Access to boutique wellness and ritual items
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Indulge in a transformative journey during a Sound Bath at HAUM in Nashville. This immersive experience uses soothing sound waves from singing bowls, gongs, and Tibetan bowls to facilitate deep relaxation and healing. Begin with intention-setting and breathwork, then let the resonant vibrations wash over you, promoting a shift into meditative states. Enhance the ritual with optional spirit cards, fire rituals, crystals etc. to elevate your senses. Perfect for those seeking spa and fun, connection with transformative nervous system reset in a serene environment.
